offence_note: Two break and enters with theft, four home invasion robberies
sentence_quote: a fit and proper sentence to be imposed upon Mr. Balfe is that advocated by defence counsel, namely, federal time of 2 years imprisonment followed by 3 years of probation
note: Credit is for house arrest and pre-trial detention; up to 9 months left to serve.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I suspend the passing of sentence, and place Mr. Terris on probation for three years with these conditions
note: Metis status card; court doubted Gladue applicability and did not decide it. Victim surcharge not imposed.

offence_note: Aggravated assault (throat cut), acquitted of attempted murder
sentence_quote: the trial judge did not err in principle in imposing a sentence of five years, nor are we of the view that the sentence is manifestly unfit
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, sentence appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Possession of stolen truck, escape from jail, obstruction of peace officer
sentence_quote: I would grant the extension of time and leave to appeal, but I would dismiss the appeal.
note: 4 months stolen truck plus consecutive 4 months escape and 2 months obstruction; earlier 15 months not added.

offence_note: Six counts of break, enter and sexual assault
sentence_quote: the sentences imposed in the case at bar for six counts of break and enter of a dwelling house and committing sexual assault of the victims are demonstrably fit
note: 20 years on four counts and 22 years on two, concurrent; pre-trial custody considered but amount not stated.

offence_note: Smuggling gold jewellery into Canada contrary to Customs Act
sentence_quote: The trial judge acceded to the joint submission for a conditional sentence of 18 months
note: Forfeiture of jewellery set aside as without jurisdiction; conditional sentence and $65,000 compensation not under appeal.

offence_note: Unlawfully at large while subject to long-term supervision order
note: Appeal allowed, conviction set aside; the 260 day sentence no longer stands.

offence_note: Dangerous driving causing death by a 16-year-old
sentence_quote: The sentence is varied to 18 months’ probation, including 100 hours of community service
note: Crown appeal allowed on YCJA constitutionality; original disposition not shown; supplementary reasons; Indigenous status inferred from Gladue report.

offence_note: Handgun offences against nightclub security guards, one seriously injured
sentence_quote: While the global sentence of 11 years (less 3 years credit for pre-trial custody for a net sentence of 8 years) was certainly towards the high end of the range, the sentence was not unreasonable.
note: Exact charges not named; offence categories inferred from description. Counts 1, 3, 4, 6 stayed.

offence_note: Mischief causing danger to life by fire; assault on corrections officer
sentence_quote: This is a sentence appeal by an 18 year old male from a global sentence of 12 months in custody
note: Six months youth sentence for mischief served in adult facility plus six months consecutive for assault.

offence_note: Firearm and taser possession, intentional discharge, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: I would allow leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.
note: Five-year mandatory minimum on discharge count; other counts six months to a year concurrent.

offence_note: Seven counts of sexual assault on clients of his clinic
sentence_quote: I sentence you to a global term of imprisonment of 11 years.
note: Consecutive sentences on seven counts; SOIRA 20 years; surcharge $1,400; mitigation only partly shown.
